title: The Mirror-Paired Hadamard Square-Denominator Identity, the Universal Conservation Law int_R K du = pi, and Stationary Trudgian Variation in the Critical Strip
description: Paper VII of the series on the Transverse Wronskian of Riemann's Xi-Function. Establishes the dual pure-square trigonometric Wronskian multiplets S_pm(d,t) and the Fejer-Lukacs Toeplitz Rayleigh maximum Lambda_max(K) = 2 cos(pi/(K+2)), the mirror-paired Hadamard square-denominator identity K(d, d_rho, u) = d(d^2 - d_rho^2 + u^2)/[((d^2 - d_rho^2 + u^2)^2 + 4u^2 d_rho^2)], monotone critical-strip penetration d_{strip,X}^{mirror}(t) under finite prime-power sieving, the universal conservation law int_{-inf}^{inf} K(d, d_rho, u) du = pi, the exact quartic difference factorization proving the hypothesis-free minorant K_min(d,u) = K(d, 1/2, u) on |u| >= H_min(d), and the d-independent stationary variational law H_opt(kt) = 2*pi*B_S(kt)/ln(kt/2pi) -> 2*pi(0.112) = 0.70371675... driven by Trudgian's explicit bound on S(T).
